bankBasis: Four reactors follow the V5.1 bank. Four dedicated recirculation / induction and solids-metering packages are a proposed configuration: the register lists P-205A/B and M-201 without assigning them to four reactors. maintenanceReview.status: Coordinated concept — lifting release remains HOLD
maintenanceReview.basis: The reserved sweep begins at the cover, includes the offset motor, and extends above the translated drive plus an illustrative rigging allowance. It is not an approved lifting envelope or hoist capacity.
maintenanceReview.layout: SC-164C/D use horizontal powered screws routed diagonally outside the rear reactor lifting reservations. Hopper fill points and branch-isolation tags are retained; no long lateral gravity chute is introduced.

shutdownInterfaces.action: Withdraw the complete feeder carriage 2.25 m rearward on fixed guides. Hopper stays on its widened independent weigh frame; front cradle is set behind head services. Distribution supports and the acid supply rack are coordinated around the complete stroke. Vendor to qualify drive, locking pins, end stops, guide reactions and withdrawal actuation.
shutdownInterfaces.status: Coordinated geometry; mechanism and structure qualification HOLD

shutdownInterfaces.interface: Pre-G chute and reactor charging connection
shutdownInterfaces.action: Removable hopper inlet neck and short reactor chute, with two split sleeve disconnects. Empty, isolate and decontaminate before disconnection; independently support and positively close all four exposed faces. Shown maintenance view includes closure plates.
shutdownInterfaces.status: Modeled interfaces; containment and isolation procedure qualification HOLD

shutdownInterfaces.interface: Liquid feeds, cleaning, vent and instrumentation
shutdownInterfaces.action: Reconcile every head service against the lift sweep and P&ID. Define isolation, decontamination and supported spool removal. Relief protection must remain appropriate to every maintenance state.

shutdownInterfaces.interface: R-201D upper sweep / rear dust trunks
shutdownInterfaces.action: Pre-G trunk rerouted to X = 3.95 m; oxidizer trunk to X = 0.80 m, outside the reserved sweep. Dust systems remain segregated. Recalculate pressure loss, balance and support loads for the changed routing.
shutdownInterfaces.status: Rerouted concept; hydraulic and support qualification HOLD

shutdownInterfaces.interface: Drive, seal services and electrical conduit
shutdownInterfaces.action: Vendor to confirm connection and removal sequence, energy isolation, independent support and reinstatement checks.
shutdownInterfaces.status: HOLD — drive and seal package unselected

shutdownInterfaces.action: The modeled impeller envelope exceeds the neck bore. Qualify split-impeller disassembly, tool access and retrieval before shaft withdrawal; do not assume passage through the neck.

shutdownInterfaces.interface: Lifting equipment, structure and elevated access
shutdownInterfaces.action: Establish lifted weights, centres of gravity, lifting points, rigging, rated hoist and supporting structure, landing space, exclusion zone and access method.
shutdownInterfaces.status: HOLD — capacity and lift plan unselected

regulatory.requirement: Crane/hoist capacity must not exceed its supporting structure capacity; a clear model envelope does not establish load capacity.
Applicable manufacturer manuals or engineer instructions must be accessible for crane/hoist use.
Determine and communicate load weight. If it cannot be accurately determined, the crane/hoist requires a load-weight indicator or overload-prevention system. This model assigns no lifted weight.

mechanicalBasis.arrangement: Top-entry agitator with an offset motor/gearbox clear of the Pre-G feeder, on a reinforced removable cover; separate recirculation suction; central flush-bottom outlet with separately isolated product and cleaning-waste branches.
mechanicalBasis.drainage: The central seat meets the inner head low point. A lowering poppet opens into a side-discharge chamber; the actuator remains below the chamber, outside the liquid path. Downstream drain routing falls to the existing closed-drain interface. Residual heel, valve internals and cleanability require vendor confirmation.
mechanicalBasis.controls: XV-BOT201 opens only for the selected reactor in illustrated collection or cleaning states. XV-COL and XV-DR201 select mutually exclusive destinations. This is an inspection simulation, not a commissioned interlock or safety system.
mechanicalBasis.maintenance: Removable drive/cover requires shutdown, isolation and a qualified lifting procedure. The split impellers require a qualified disassembly sequence before shaft withdrawal through the smaller cover neck. Elevated access, service disconnects and lifting remain HOLD; screening envelopes are illustrative.

qualification: Model checks only. No process capacity, pressure rating or operating release established.

findings.reason: Each reactor needs an explicitly assigned feed, circulation and transfer arrangement.
findings.observation: Four reactors follow the V5.1 bank. Four dedicated recirculation / induction and solids-metering packages are a proposed configuration: the register lists P-205A/B and M-201 without assigning them to four reactors. P-206A/B are selectable transfer pumps; duty/standby and simultaneous operation are unconfirmed. No rated capacity or operating setpoint is implied.
findings.action: Reconcile the four-package model with the equipment register and P&ID; establish shared versus dedicated duties and simultaneous operation.

findings.reason: Dosing requires a known source, destination and permissive basis.
findings.observation: The model includes separate solids-metering and induction assemblies. Their existence does not establish allowable addition rate or reaction control.
findings.action: Confirm feed properties, dosing envelope, calorimetry, mixing/recirculation requirements and the cause-and-effect matrix.

findings.reason: Sampling must not inadvertently open product, waste or recovery paths.
findings.observation: 80 sampling scenarios passed the existing model test. Main product, cleaning-waste and recovery valves remained closed in those cases. This is simulation evidence, not commissioned protection.
findings.action: Verify pump duty, suction conditions, line sizing, actual sample receiver arrangements, valve fail positions and independent protection requirements.

findings.reason: The connected utility must remove the required heat across the jacket and any intermediate exchanger.
findings.observation: The model represents jacket connections. The A-5000 review retains unresolved secondary temperatures and exchanger performance; this review performs no new heat-duty calculation.
findings.action: Complete the batch heat balance and reaction calorimetry; establish secondary temperatures, circulation, exchanger duty and cooling-loss response.

findings.reason: Maintenance must provide a physically achievable removal sequence with rated lifting equipment.
findings.observation: The mechanical basis records that the impeller envelope exceeds the cover neck bore. Split-impeller disassembly and retrieval must be qualified. Tests confirmed 16 modeled positive maintenance closures and restoration of all four feeder branches to their operating positions.
findings.action: Obtain the vendor disassembly procedure, task access, lifted masses, rigging, support capacity and service-disconnection sequence.

findings.reason: Residual process liquid needs an accessible, defined receiving path and an assessed capture arrangement.
findings.observation: The central seat meets the inner head low point. A lowering poppet opens into a side-discharge chamber; the actuator remains below the chamber, outside the liquid path. Downstream drain routing falls to the existing closed-drain interface. Residual heel, valve internals and cleanability require vendor confirmation. This review does not recalculate containment capacity or prove chemical compatibility.
findings.action: Verify residual heel, dead legs, destination, isolation, receiving capacity and the applicable containment inventory. Review surrounding containment in the full plant.

findings.reason: Each gas and pressure interface needs an identified function, destination and design basis.
findings.observation: Attached service geometry can be inspected in the assembly image. This assessment has not verified relief sizing, vent capacity, purge demand or compatibility of combined sources.
findings.action: Reconcile nozzle and line tags to the P&ID; confirm normal vent and relief destinations, backpressure, purge basis and source compatibility.
